query:
SELECT sentBy, subject, status, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM leadActivities
WHERE sentBy LIKE 'n8n_dispatcher%'
  AND DATE(createdAt) = '2026-06-09'
GROUP BY sentBy, subject, status
ORDER BY cnt DESC;
